title: Lefthanders and Righthanders
statementMd:
One fine October day a mathematics teacher Vasily Petrov went to a class and saw there $*n*$ pupils who sat at the ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a64c1b2df604f8cfa9acf6716a3cc1424488361e.png) desks, two people at each desk. Vasily quickly realized that number $*n*$ is even. Like all true mathematicians, Vasily has all students numbered from 1 to $*n*$.

But Vasily Petrov did not like the way the children were seated at the desks. According to him, the students whose numbers differ by $1$, can not sit together, as they talk to each other all the time, distract others and misbehave.

On the other hand, if a righthanded student sits at the left end of the desk and a lefthanded student sits at the right end of the desk, they hit elbows all the time and distract each other. In other cases, the students who sit at the same desk, do not interfere with each other.

Vasily knows very well which students are lefthanders and which ones are righthanders, and he asks you to come up with any order that meets these two uncomplicated conditions (students do not talk to each other and do not bump their elbows). It is guaranteed that the input is such that at least one way to seat the students always exists.

## Input

The first input line contains a single even integer $*n*$ ($4 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$) — the number of students in the class. The second line contains exactly $*n*$ capital English letters "L" and "R". If the $*i*$-th letter at the second line equals "L", then the student number $*i*$ is a lefthander, otherwise he is a righthander.

## Output

Print ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a64c1b2df604f8cfa9acf6716a3cc1424488361e.png) integer pairs, one pair per line. In the $*i*$-th line print the numbers of students that will sit at the $*i*$-th desk. The first number in the pair stands for the student who is sitting to the left, and the second number stands for the student who is sitting to the right. Separate the numbers in the pairs by spaces. If there are multiple solutions, print any of them.
statementZhMd:
某个美好的十月天，数学老师 Vasily Petrov 来到一个班级，看到那里有 $*n*$ 名学生，他们坐在 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a64c1b2df604f8cfa9acf6716a3cc1424488361e.png) 张课桌旁，每张课桌坐两个人。Vasily 很快意识到，数字 $*n*$ 是偶数。像所有真正的数学家一样，Vasily 给所有学生编号为 1 到 $*n*$。

但是 Vasily Petrov 不喜欢孩子们坐在课桌旁的方式。在他看来，编号相差 $1$ 的学生不能坐在一起，因为他们一直互相交谈，打扰其他人并且行为不端。

另一方面，如果一个右撇子学生坐在课桌的左端，而一个左撇子学生坐在课桌的右端，那么他们的胳膊肘会一直碰在一起，互相打扰。在其他情况下，坐在同一张课桌旁的学生不会互相干扰。

Vasily 非常清楚哪些学生是左撇子，哪些学生是右撇子，因此他请你给出一种满足以下两个简单条件的任意排列方式（学生不会互相交谈，也不会碰到胳膊肘）。保证输入数据满足条件，总是至少存在一种安排学生就座的方式。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个偶数 $*n*$（$4 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$）——班级中的学生人数。第二行恰好包含 $*n*$ 个大写英文字母 "L" 和 "R"。如果第二行中的第 $*i*$ 个字母等于 "L"，那么编号为 $*i*$ 的学生是左撇子，否则他是右撇子。

## 输出格式

输出 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a64c1b2df604f8cfa9acf6716a3cc1424488361e.png) 对整数，每行输出一对。在第 $*i*$ 行输出将坐在第 $*i*$ 张课桌旁的学生编号。每对中的第一个数字表示坐在左边的学生，第二个数字表示坐在右边的学生。每对中的两个数字之间用空格分隔。如果有多种解，输出任意一种即可。
